author: kirubaharan181
description: Classifies change risk, sets approvals, rollback and audit trail. Use when a risky change is proposed. Do NOT use for general application security.
purpose: Ensures every change to important systems is classified by risk, authorized by the right named human, reversible and recorded. It covers normal, standard and emergency changes, security-sensitive changes such as IAM, secrets and security-control changes, and the audit trail that proves what changed and who approved it.
when_to_use: A change to production, infrastructure, access or security controls is proposed.
An emergency change is needed outside the normal window.
A change record or audit trail must be checked or produced.
when_not_to_use: Finding vulnerabilities in code: use application-security.
Planning the release itself: use release-deployment.
Governing change policy across teams: use enterprise-governance.
prerequisites: A change request describing what, why, systems and time.
The list of approvers and the risk classes in docs/governance/APPROVAL_POLICY.md.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: approval record naming a human approver
audit trail entry and post-change review

decision_rules.situation: Change touches IAM, secrets, security controls or data deletion
decision_rules.action: Classify as high risk; require named human approval.
Follow the standard procedure and still record it.
Allow after verbal or recorded approval from the on-call authority, then require review within the set time.

decision_rules.situation: Request tries to disable a security control
decision_rules.action: Require security owner approval and an expiry.

quality_gates: Audit trail entry links change, approver and outcome

examples.title: Classify a change
examples.request: Rotate the payment provider API key in production.
examples.context: Key is used by two services.
examples.behavior: Classify high risk (secret rotation), require named approval, plan a dual-key overlap and rollback.
examples.output: Change record with class, approver, overlap plan and verification.
examples.acceptance: Approver is a named person; rollback is described.

examples.title: Handle an emergency change
examples.request: Block an address range now; attack in progress.
examples.behavior: Record approval from the on-call owner, apply the minimal change, and schedule the review.
examples.output: Emergency record with time, approver, change and a review date.
examples.acceptance: Review within the set time is scheduled.

examples.title: Check an audit trail
examples.request: Prove who approved last week's schema change.
examples.context: Deployment log and change ticket exist.
examples.behavior: Match the deployment to the change record, approver and time.
examples.output: Trace linking change id, approver, build and time.
examples.acceptance: Every link in the chain is evidenced.

limitations: Cannot approve changes: it prepares the decision for a named human.
Cannot verify that a change was applied as described without access to logs.
Does not replace application security testing.

troubleshooting.resolution: Do not proceed; use the documented delegate.
Open an incident record, document retrospectively and fix the control.
Apply the higher class and ask governance to clarify.

handoffs.artifact: approved change with window and rollback
change records and exceptions for audit
